notes.title: Patch v1.0.3 release
notes.content: - Fix hang that would occur if you made a custom map containing a "U" shape of blue rock, and detonated a bomb inside it

notes.title: v1.0.2
notes.content:
Fix a crash when pushing blocks offscreen at the same time as cutting them with a megadrill
 Tweak babyaga level so you can't blast blocks offscreen
 Fix bombs double exploding under certain circumstances
